description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.14): what changes at stage 4 - lone humans flee, formations hold, towns meet the giant on their greens, gates can be breached.
text: At this size lone soldiers break and run from you, and townsfolk step out of your way. Formations hold together: they lock as one target. Fortified gates and boulders now give way to your blows, and the deep Wend is only knee-deep.
